prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a low-speed head-on collision in Conroe, Texas, and has shoulder injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1309; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my name on a recording right now. I'm still pretty shaken up about the accident.

Q: That's understandable. Can you confirm you were the driver of the vehicle involved in the collision?

A: Yes, I was driving.

Q: Tell me in your own words what happened.

A: I was heading down the road in Conroe, going maybe thirty-five miles an hour. The other car came over into my lane. We hit head-on, but it wasn't a hard hit, more like a bump that jolted everything.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, I always do.

Q: Did the airbags deploy?

A: No, they didn't. The steering wheel jerked and I felt my shoulder slam against the door frame.

Q: Where are you experiencing pain or symptoms now?

A: My right shoulder mainly. It's sore when I lift my arm, and I've got a dull ache that runs into my neck.

Q: Have you sought medical treatment since the collision?

A: Yes, I went to urgent care that same afternoon. They took X-rays and told me to follow up with an orthopedic doctor.

Q: Did you have any pain or problems with that shoulder before this accident?

A: No, not that I can recall. I play softball on weekends and had no trouble.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Just that I'm trying to get back to work and I can't lift anything heavy right now. I'd appreciate hearing what the next steps are.

Q: Thank you. We'll be in touch with you about those next steps.
